description: cfd_2d_cpm_bedload_layer_hyb in 3D (4 cells in y): the hybrid suspension (Q 58 3) with the 3D face flux D 11 2, which has no vertical flux next to the bed. The concentration takes no flux through the closed faces (suspended_IM1::fill_facevel), so the exchange with the bed is erosion w_s c_be and deposition w_s c_1 only (before: the deposition stayed in the water in 3D, the suspended volume grew to 2.5 times that of the 2D case and the bed gained parcels). Checked through the CPM log: parcels, sediment volume and suspended volume
covers: CPM hybrid suspension in 3D: accounts of the columns in x and y
